name: Road to Doomsday
description: Representative curated viewing guide preparing viewers for Avengers: Doomsday across four distinct narrative tiers.

entries.title: Avengers: Infinity War
entries.whyWatchThis: Establishes the cosmic stakes, catastrophic loss, and narrative scale necessary to understand the multiversal desperation.
keyPlotPoints: Thanos collects the Infinity Stones
The Blip eliminates 50% of all universal life

entries.title: Avengers: Endgame
entries.whyWatchThis: Introduces quantum time travel, branch timelines, and establishes the foundation for multiversal fracturing.
keyPlotPoints: Time Heist creates divergent alternate branch timelines
Tony Stark sacrifices himself using the Nano Gauntlet

entries.title: Loki
entries.whyWatchThis: Defines TVA mechanics, timeline branching, timeline death, and Loki's transformation into the multiversal anchor.
keyPlotPoints: Destruction of the Sacred Timeline threshold
Loki assumes the throne holding multiversal branches together

entries.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
entries.whyWatchThis: First major cinematic collision between multiple cinematic Marvel continuities and universes.
keyPlotPoints: Spell of Runes breakdown opens dimensional breaches
Convergence of legacy villains and Spider-Man variants

entries.title: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
entries.whyWatchThis: Explicitly introduces the concept and danger of Incursions — the collision and destruction of two universes.
keyPlotPoints: Dreamwalking corrupted by the Darkhold
Warning and demonstration of catastrophic multiversal Incursions

entries.title: Deadpool & Wolverine
entries.whyWatchThis: Introduces Anchor Beings and bridges the 20th Century Fox Marvel legacy continuity into the connected multiverse.
keyPlotPoints: Anchor Being mechanics and timeline decay
The Void and resistance survivors from pruned universes

entries.title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
entries.whyWatchThis: Crucial character arcs for Steve Rogers, Bucky Barnes, and Sam Wilson forming the moral bedrock of Earth's defense.
keyPlotPoints: Collapse of S.H.I.E.L.D. from internal Hydra infiltration
Survival of Bucky Barnes as the Winter Soldier

entries.title: WandaVision
entries.whyWatchThis: Traces Wanda Maximoff's grief-fueled evolution into the mythical Scarlet Witch, setting up multiversal peril.
keyPlotPoints: Creation and dissipation of the Westview Hex
Wanda claims the mantle of Scarlet Witch and discovers the Darkhold

entries.title: The Avengers
entries.whyWatchThis: The genesis of Earth's Mightiest Heroes teaming up against extraterrestrial threats.
keyPlotPoints: Battle of New York unites the original six Avengers
First post-credits reveal of Thanos

entries.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
entries.whyWatchThis: Expands Marvel cosmic scope and provides lore regarding the origin and power of Infinity Stones.
keyPlotPoints: The Collector explains the ancient genesis of the Infinity Stones
The Power Stone is secured by the Nova Corps

entries.title: Captain America: Civil War
entries.whyWatchThis: Fracturing of the Avengers via Sokovia Accords; establishes ideological divisions and team fragmentation persisting into multiversal team-ups.
keyPlotPoints: Sokovia Accords divide the Avengers into opposing factions
Rift between Tony Stark and Steve Rogers fractures Earth's defense network

entries.title: Avengers: Doomsday
entries.whyWatchThis: The culmination destination of the Multiverse Saga where Doctor Doom challenges realities across the multiverse.
keyPlotPoints: Victor von Doom emerges as the multiversal threat
Heroes across realities assemble against complete multiversal collapse

entries.title: The Fantastic Four: First Steps
entries.whyWatchThis: Introduces Marvel's First Family arriving from an alternate retro-futuristic reality into the MCU; establishes their arch-nemesis Doctor Doom and positions Reed Richards as a central protagonist.
keyPlotPoints: First Family origins and arrival into the broader Marvel continuity
Foundational multiversal dynamics setting up Doctor Doom's prominence

entries.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp: Quantumania
entries.whyWatchThis: Unveils the Quantum Realm outside conventional space-time and introduces the multiversal Council of Kangs.
keyPlotPoints: Kang the Conqueror's exile in the Quantum Realm
Council of Kangs gathers across the multiversal branches

entries.title: Captain Marvel
entries.whyWatchThis: Establishes Carol Danvers' cosmic power tier, the history of the Tesseract, and deep-space Marvel alliances.
keyPlotPoints: Carol Danvers absorbs Space Stone energy
Kree-Skrull conflict establishes cosmic geopolitical backdrop

entries.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
entries.whyWatchThis: Shuri assumes the mantle of Black Panther; introduces Talokan and Namor amidst global tensions over vibranium access.
keyPlotPoints: Death of King T'Challa and succession of Shuri as Black Panther
Emergence of Namor and secret underwater civilization of Talokan

entries.title: Thunderbolts*
entries.whyWatchThis: Assembles Earth's anti-hero operative squad (Bucky Barnes, Yelena Belova, John Walker) alongside Sentry directly preceding the Doomsday crisis.
keyPlotPoints: Government-assembled strike team operating in the shadows
Introduction of Bob Reynolds / Sentry as a destabilizing power

entries.title: Captain America: Brave New World
entries.whyWatchThis: Sam Wilson steps forward as Captain America to lead global defense amid political conspiracy and the emergence of Red Hulk.
keyPlotPoints: International scramble over Adamantium from Celestial Tiamut
President Thaddeus Ross transforms into Red Hulk

entries.title: Iron Man
entries.whyWatchThis: The foundational genesis of the MCU and Tony Stark's heroic journey; vital thematic resonance with Robert Downey Jr.'s return as Victor von Doom.
keyPlotPoints: Tony Stark builds the Mark I armor and embraces his destiny
Birth of the Marvel Cinematic Universe with Nick Fury's Avengers Initiative

entries.title: Black Panther
entries.whyWatchThis: Origins of Wakanda, vibranium technology, and the philosophical debate between isolationism and global aid.
keyPlotPoints: T'Challa ascends the throne as King of Wakanda
Wakanda reveals its true technology and opens borders to the world

entries.title: Thor: Ragnarok
entries.whyWatchThis: Thor's loss of Mjolnir, destruction of Asgard, and partnership with Hulk leading immediately into Infinity War.
keyPlotPoints: Destruction of Mjolnir and Asgard by Hela and Surtur
Thor embraces his innate godly power without his hammer

entries.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
entries.whyWatchThis: Creation of Vision with the Mind Stone, introduction of Wanda Maximoff, and the devastation of Sokovia.
keyPlotPoints: Creation and destruction of Ultron; birth of Vision
Sokovia's destruction lays the political catalyst for the Accords

entries.title: Agatha All Along
entries.whyWatchThis: Direct WandaVision sequel exploring dark magic, the Witches' Road, and introducing the reincarnated Billy Maximoff (Wiccan).
keyPlotPoints: Agatha Harkness and her coven walk the Witches' Road
Billy Maximoff emerges as the magical successor to the Scarlet Witch
